Messages.Author: Stephen Beaulieu
Messages.Body:
In article <3147DF...@uni-muenster.de>, Marc Erl
<er...@uni-muenster.de> wrote:

: Greetings to thee...

: Well, this is probably most boring for all who are in this News Group
: for some time already, but we in our play circle keep argueing about
: this one and would apreciate some statements: the rule state that only
: one of a specific reaction card may be played at a time. Does that mean
: by ONE Minion? Example: My Predator nastily does a conditioning bleed
: with a total of 4. I have two untapped Vamps with superior auspex out...
: so, may I play one Telepathic Counter with each to reduce the bleed to
: zero??? Is it possible to use two Surprise Influence during a political
: action when two untapped Vamps are available?
: Thanks in advance bye Marc

You may play one reaction card of a given type per minion per action. So
you can go ahead and use 2 Telepathic Counters with 2 minions to reduce
the bleed completely.

In the original Jyhad rules there were conflicting sections of the rules.
One stated each minion could use a given reaction card once during an
action. The other stated that only one reaction card of a given type
could be used per action (which would mean only one TC per bleed
regardless of how many minions, also only one Wake per action by a given
Meth.) To solve the conflict the Design Team ruled that it was properly
one reaction per minion per action.

I actually prefered playing the other way, as it made games a little more
strategic, having to carefully choose which minion to attempt to block
with and so on... but it's not that big of a deal. Just a personal
preference from way back when.

I hope this helps
